projects.title: Flintstone Real Estate
projects.summary: A brand identity for Flintstone Real Estate, a builder of luxury custom homes. The identity is built around one idea: "Building your vision, stone by stone. Est. 2025"

sections.heading: The brief
sections.text: Flintstone builds luxurious, custom homes that blend timeless design with modern innovation. The brand needed to feel as solid as the buildings: premium, durable and trustworthy.

sections.heading: Concept: stone by stone
sections.text: The tagline "Building your vision, stone by stone" shaped everything. The F monogram is built from solid blocks, like stones laid one on another, on a simple grid so it stays sharp from a hard hat to a billboard.

sections.heading: Color and typography
sections.text: A deep midnight blue and crisp white give the brand a calm, premium feel. Widely spaced, light lettering keeps it modern and luxurious.

sections.heading: Four brand pillars
sections.text: Luxury, Modern, Quality, Durable. These four words guide the visuals and the voice, ending in the promise: "not just houses, but enduring homes."

sections.heading: On the building site
sections.text: The identity is made for the places clients actually see it: hard hats, site hoarding, signage, vehicles and stationery. Every piece uses the same grid, colours and logo placement.
